hook_anchors.excerpt: By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion.
hook_anchors.why: High Priest dramatically interrupts the ceremony to seize the sanctuary.

hook_anchors.excerpt: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!
hook_anchors.why: Juliana passionately defies the High Priest in front of everyone.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: Will Alexander lose Juliana at the council trial in ten days?
cliffhanger_anchors.excerpt: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.
cliffhanger_anchors.why: Sets up a high-stakes countdown ultimatum for the protagonist.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: What scheme will Catherine execute before the ten-day deadline?
cliffhanger_anchors.excerpt: Ten days is plenty of time.
cliffhanger_anchors.why: Catherine's malicious smirk and whisper provide a ominous closing sting promise.
